title.zh: 量测闭环：看空间模式再动作
title.en: Close the metrology loop: inspect spatial patterns before acting

subtitle.zh: Wafer Map / SPC / FDC / 复测

body.zh: 01 建立基准Map；收集稳定批次，建立参考
body.en: 01 Build a reference map Collect stable lots to establish a reference

body.zh: 02；识别空间模式；对比当前批次，识别异常
body.en: 02 Identify spatial patterns Compare the current lot and identify anomalies

body.zh: 03 关联设备与来料；多源数据交叉诊断；来料；光刻；沉积；刻蚀；量测/ 设备信号 /工艺参数
body.en: 03 Correlate equipment and incoming material Cross-diagnose multiple data sources Incoming material Lithography Deposition Etching Metrology / equipment signals / process parameters

body.zh: 04 提出根因假设；基于证据定位关键因素
body.en: 04 Propose a root-cause hypothesis Use evidence to locate key factors

body.zh: 05；验证片或DOE确认；小批量验证，确认改善效果；验证前；验证后
body.en: 05 Confirm with validation wafers or DOE Validate a small batch to confirm improvement Before validation After validation

body.zh: 06 反馈、前馈或维护；固化措施，防止再次发生
body.en: 06 Feedback, feedforward or maintenance Standardize countermeasures to prevent recurrence

body.zh: 典型空间模式；径向；局部；边缘；时间漂移
body.en: Typical spatial patterns Radial Local Edge Time drift

body.zh: 量测采样策略；•采样点位；•采样频率；• 关键结构；• 数据质量
body.en: Metrology sampling strategy • Sampling locations • Sampling frequency • Critical structures • Data quality

body.zh: SPC控制限；•监控趋势；• 区分波动；• 识别异常；• 支持决策
body.en: SPC control limits • Monitor trends • Distinguish variation • Identify anomalies • Support decisions

body.zh: FDC传感器健康；•等离子体信号；• 真空与气体流量；• 温度与射频；• 设备状态监控
body.en: FDC sensor health • Plasma signals • Vacuum and gas flow • Temperature and RF • Equipment-state monitoring

body.zh: 执行器与处置规则；• 工艺参数调整；•设备维护保养；• 前馈补偿策略；•异常处置规则
body.en: Actuators and disposition rules • Process-parameter adjustment • Equipment maintenance • Feedforward compensation • Abnormality-disposition rules

body.zh: 耦合提示：只优化深度均匀性，可能损害CD、轮廓与选择比
body.en: Coupling warning: optimizing depth uniformity alone can harm CD, profile and selectivity

body.zh: 量测反馈：深度/CD / 截面/缺陷/电性
body.en: Metrology feedback: depth / CD / cross section / defects / electrical properties

topic: 刻蚀均匀性与腔体控制
